```{r}
library(inflascope)
calculate_inflation(150,159)
compare_rural_urban()
simulate_budget(25000,c(Food=.47,`Non-food`=.53),c(Food=8,`Non-food`=4))
```

Launch the interactive app using `launch_app()`. Numerical basket inputs are illustrative assumptions.
